artworks.title: Bathers
artworks.medium: black chalk on green laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of abstract humanoid figures. The drawing consists of two main sets of figures, one pair of figures at the top and an individual figure at the bottom. The figures are roughly sketched using light lines. The top figures consist of one standing figure and one seated or crouched figure, while the bottom figure appears to be in motion. The background is plain, emphasizing the figures. The simplicity of the lines and lack of detail in the figuration suggest an emphasis on capturing motion or form.

artworks.title: Study of a Man
artworks.medium: black chalk with black crayon and traces of graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a partial view of a person's upper body in a side profile. The individual's face and upper torso are depicted, with exaggerated facial features and deep lines defining their structure. The hair is textured with rough lines, and the clothing lines are loose and flowing. The background is plain and neutral, with no visible jewelry or objects in the scene.

artworks.title: Scene of the Tribunal (The Verdict)
artworks.medium: pen and ink over charcoal, pieced on laid paper and laid down
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a courtroom scene. The drawing shows various sections with line sketches illustrating different parts of the scene. In the middle section, a crucifix is visible on the wall. Several figures are depicted, some in long robes and headwear, while others appear to be observers or participants. One figure in the center seems to be engaging in writing or reading near a desk. In the lower right portion, a figure appears to lean over another. The drawing is simplistic, focusing on capturing the essence and positioning of subjects within a structured environment.

artworks.title: The Smoker
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and charcoal on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of two figures, with both only visible from the waist up. The person to the right is seated in a profile view, facing slightly toward the left. This person's facial features are softly sketched without much detail, and they appear to have long hair. They are wearing a loosely drawn garment. The person on the left side of the drawing is depicted in a more detailed style, facing forward. This figure has more pronounced facial features, including a prominent nose and distinctive lines suggesting expression. The figure is wearing a hat and a textured garment. The background of the image is plain, with the drawing set against a blank canvas.

artworks.title: Sheet of Studies with Two Large Men on the Ground
artworks.medium: black chalk and graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various forms and sketches on a sheet. The artwork consists of quick, rough sketches that form shapes on a lightly marked sheet. There are several forms across the page, with one group of figures clustered towards the bottom left. Above this, there are faint lines suggesting other abstract shapes. In the top right corner, there are the outlines of figures or small groups. Towards the bottom right corner, there's a rough shape resembling a head or skull-like feature. The drawing is minimalistic with loose, free-flowing lines.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Son
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with black wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple overlapping sketches of figures in various poses. The drawing is composed of rough, gestural lines forming several figures grouped together in different arrangements across the paper. Each figure appears to be intertwined with others, creating a sense of movement and interaction. The lines are loose and spontaneous, conveying a sketch-like, exploratory nature to the composition. The figures are shown standing, sitting, and leaning, with a sense of gravity and balance. The use of ink wash adds contrast and depth to certain parts, highlighting one of the groups especially in the lower right. The paper has a natural beige tone.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Son
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a lightly sketched drawing of a person, with a partial view of the body. The figure is in a posture that suggests leaning forward or embracing something, with the head slightly bowed. The facial features are minimal and abstract, and the hair is depicted simply. Flowing lines around the figure suggest clothing, but no detailed attire is shown. The background is a plain, textured paper surface with pencil marks and the word "Regina" written upside down on the right side. The composition is simplistic and abstract, with no other elements in the surrounding area.

artworks.title: Centaur Carrying Off a Woman
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with wash over crayon on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows swirling and curved lines creating an abstract composition. The lines converge to resemble a pair of figures entwined together, one with an arm extended upward. The background consists of additional abstract shapes and meandering lines.

artworks.title: Don Quixote
artworks.medium: crayon on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a figure on horseback in a light, sketchy style. The horse is depicted in motion, with extended legs. The rider holds an object that resembles a lance or pole. Soft lines in the background convey a sense of movement and speed.

artworks.title: Actor Posing in Front of a Mirror
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with crayon and watercolor on heavy laid paper
artworks.description: A figure is shown in a three-quarter view, with the upper body visible beside a mirror. The person is depicted in a dynamic pose with one arm raised above their head. The facial features are drawn with distinct lines, emphasizing a sharp nose, prominent cheekbones, and an open mouth. The individual has curly hair. They are wearing a long garment with a slightly open collar. The mirror reflects a distorted version of the person, emphasizing the wildness of their hair and expression. Objects surround the mirror. The background is a dark, wash-colored wall.

artworks.title: Lawyer
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person standing. The person is facing slightly to the left, with one arm potentially outstretched. The sketch shows indistinct facial features with a suggestion of a beard, and the person appears to be wearing a hat or cap. They are depicted in a long robe or garment. The background is plain, showing the texture of the paper with some minor discolorations.

artworks.title: Dancer
artworks.medium: crayon over charcoal on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person shown in motion, in a dancing pose. The individual is leaning forward with one leg extended and the other slightly bent. The face is not detailed, with an outline and a hairstyle resembling a bun. The person is wearing a flowing dress or skirt, with expressive lines indicating movement. No jewelry or objects are visible, and the background is plain with shadowy lines suggesting movement.

artworks.title: The Grandmother
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows the upper bodies and heads of two figures. An older person is seated and holding a baby. The older person is sitting with their head slightly tilted upwards, gazing at the baby. Their facial features are aged with prominent lines, and they have short hair styled close to the head. They are wearing a loose-fitting garment with long sleeves. The baby is facing the older person, supported by their arms and legs resting on their lap. The baby appears to have a smooth head and its body is depicted with sketchy lines. No additional objects can be seen. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Scene in a Palace of Justice
artworks.medium: black chalk with wash marks on brown paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an abstract scene. The drawing shows two main sections. On the left, there are rough outline sketches of figures in motion, with the central figure appearing more prominently in a larger cloak-like garment. The hinted architecture or framing around the figures suggests an interior space. On the right, within a separate outlined rectangle, there are two elongated figures, one seemingly pointing or gesturing towards the other. Below this, scribbled forms suggest a crowd of indistinct observers. The drawing is rendered in pencil with some areas of darker shading or ink and features abstract shading to the right, heightening the sense of depth or movement within the composition.

artworks.title: The Reading
artworks.medium: charcoal and crayon on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of three people sitting in chairs, each depicted from the waist up in a side or slightly angled view. The person on the left is seated with legs slightly apart and clasped hands. The person in the middle leans forward with elbows on their knees and hands extended towards the center. The individual on the right is slightly turned away with arms at their sides. Facial features are not detailed, and hair is minimally portrayed in the rough sketch style. Clothing is depicted in loose, flowing lines. No jewelry or objects are shown. The background is lightly shaded with no specific elements.

artworks.title: Woman with Veil
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a person from the waist up in a seated position. The individual's body is slightly turned to one side, with arms resting along their torso. The facial features are defined with confident lines, including eyes, nose, and a subtle smile. The hair is depicted with wavy lines, suggesting a textured style. The person appears unclothed, and there are no visible jewelry items or objects. The background is a plain, lightly textured surface.

artworks.title: Head of a Man
artworks.medium: black chalk with brown, orange, and blue wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a painted portrait showing only the head and face in profile view. The person is positioned with their face in profile, looking towards the left side of the image. The facial features are abstract and somewhat indistinct, with muted tones suggesting the contours of the nose, lips, and chin. The person appears to have long hair styled back, with tones of brown creating the impression of length. There are no visible clothing items or additional objects in the image. The background is a pale, textured surface.

artworks.title: Head of a Man

artworks.description: The image displays the upper part of a person's body, focusing on the head and shoulders. The figure is portrayed in a side profile position. The individual's hair is shown in dark tones with flowing lines, suggesting a tousled style. Facial features are not clearly defined due to the impressionistic style of the drawing. Clothing is indicated with soft brown and black strokes, providing depth to the shoulder area. The background is a textured, neutral-toned surface. There are no discernible objects or jewelry visible, and the overall tone is abstract.

artworks.title: Head of a Man
artworks.medium: black, brown, and white crayon on gray paper
artworks.description: The image shows a partial depiction of a person's face in profile. The figure is facing right with a slightly hunched position. The facial features are outlined with light and dark tones, emphasizing the nose, brow, and mouth. The person wears a dark hat tilted back. The drawing is composed of simple, sketch-like lines with an impressionistic quality. The background is a plain, textured grey surface, with a faint horizontal line at the top.

artworks.title: Head of a Man
artworks.medium: watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a watercolor painting of a person depicted from the shoulders up. The subject is positioned slightly facing to their left, with their head tilted slightly downward and to the side. The facial features are softly rendered with prominent cheeks and a distinct nose, while the hair is sketchily indicated and appears to be short. The person is not wearing any visible clothing or jewelry. They are surrounded by a light wash of colorless tones, suggesting neutral surroundings that provide little context. The background is composed of soft blue and light beige, blending together gently, creating a muted and uncluttered atmosphere that does not distract from the subject.

artworks.title: Head of a Man

artworks.description: The image depicts a partial illustration of a person, with only the head and shoulders visible. The individual is positioned in a three-quarter view, seemingly turning away from the viewer. The facial features are simplified, appearing sketch-like, with a prominent nose and a hint of facial structure suggested by watercolor washes. The hair is rendered with a rough outline, suggesting it is sparse or closely cropped to the head. The person appears to be wearing a garment hinted at by blue and reddish-brown tones across the shoulder area. The background is minimal, showcasing a light tone with abstract, watercolor strokes, providing an indistinct frame that emphasizes the figure.

artworks.title: Head of a Man

artworks.description: The image shows a watercolor painting of a person depicted from the shoulders up, in profile. The individual has a bowed head and softly rendered facial features. The person’s hair is shown in a loose style, blending into the head. They are wearing a blue garment. The background is minimal and neutral, with gentle washes of color. There are no visible jewelry or objects in the person's hands.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Son
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of two individuals in a dynamic interaction. One figure is bent over, while the second figure stands closely behind, with arms around the first, possibly assisting or supporting them. The sketch style is loose with flowing lines that suggest movement, but there are no details on facial features or hair. The figures lack detailed clothing details, giving them a more sculptural quality with emphasized anatomical lines. The background is plain and unadorned, directing focus to the figures. The sketch is monochromatic with light shading, providing depth and dimension to the figures.

artworks.title: The Prodigal Son

The person on the left is bent forward at the waist, leaning towards the other person, who stands upright. The figures are draped in loose, flowing garments. The drawing lacks detailed facial features and depicts suggested outlines for hair. The background is plain, emphasizing the figures with no additional elements.
